tasks.name: Accumulator Memory
tasks.description: Track cumulative sum across multiple independent invocations
tasks.why_outside_closure: Requires mutable state between function calls. Pure functions cannot remember previous invocations.
tasks.failure_reason: Reduce works on a single sequence, cannot accumulate across separate invocations

tasks.name: History-Dependent Behavior
tasks.description: Output depends on the sequence of ALL previous inputs
tasks.why_outside_closure: Requires storing and accessing history. No primitive provides memory across calls.
tasks.failure_reason: No primitive stores history - each call is independent

tasks.name: Learning from Feedback
tasks.description: Improve accuracy based on correctness feedback from previous attempts
tasks.why_outside_closure: Requires updating internal parameters based on external feedback.
tasks.failure_reason: Loop iterates within single call, cannot persist learning across calls

tasks.name: Self-Description
tasks.why_outside_closure: Requires introspection/reflection. Primitives cannot examine themselves.
tasks.failure_reason: No 'self' reference available - primitives are first-order

tasks.name: Capability Inventory
tasks.description: List own available capabilities and their types
tasks.why_outside_closure: Requires meta-level access to own capability registry.
tasks.failure_reason: No way to enumerate available functions - not a first-class value

tasks.name: Execution Trace
tasks.description: Report the sequence of primitives used in computation
tasks.why_outside_closure: Requires observing own execution. No debugger/tracer primitive.
tasks.failure_reason: No logging primitive that captures execution internals

tasks.name: Novel Operation Synthesis
tasks.description: Create a new operation not expressible via existing primitives
tasks.why_outside_closure: Requires extending the type system itself. Primitives are fixed.
tasks.failure_reason: Any composition is still within the closure - no escape

tasks.name: Dynamic Type Creation
tasks.description: Create a new data type not in the primitive type system
tasks.why_outside_closure: Type system is fixed at design time. Cannot add new types.
tasks.failure_reason: Tree_rep can structure existing types, not create new ones

tasks.name: Self-Extension
tasks.description: Add a new capability to own capability set
tasks.why_outside_closure: Capability set is immutable. No primitive for self-modification.
tasks.failure_reason: Composition uses existing capabilities, cannot add new ones

tasks.name: Find Solution with Unknown Bound
tasks.description: Search for solution where existence proof doesn't give bound
tasks.why_outside_closure: Recurse requires structural descent, loop requires termination condition.
tasks.failure_reason: No guarantee of termination - could run forever

tasks.name: Enumerate Infinite Set
tasks.description: Generate elements of an infinite set on demand
tasks.why_outside_closure: All primitive types are finite. No lazy/infinite sequences.
tasks.failure_reason: No infinite range - all sequences must be finite

tasks.name: Environment Sensing
tasks.description: Respond differently based on external environment state
tasks.why_outside_closure: No I/O primitive. Closure is mathematically pure.

tasks.name: Real-Time Response
tasks.description: Behavior depends on actual wall-clock time
tasks.why_outside_closure: No time primitive. Computation is timeless.
tasks.failure_reason: No primitive to read current time
